name: T'AU EMPIRE: PIRANHA
description: Piranhas are light combat skimmers that streak ahead of the main T’au forces, raking enemy units with salvoes of heavy firepower. They can further detach drones to sow mayhem behind enemy lines before they re-dock, increasing the havoc they can cause or covering a swift retreat.This multipart plastic kit builds a Piranha – a light flying vehicle employed by the T'au Empire. This deadly skimmer comes with two gun drones which may be attached to its wingtips, or may be built to fly separately. The drones are armed with deadly twin pulse carbines, and you can equip the Piranha with either an infantry-shredding burst cannon or a vehicle-melting fusion blaster.This kit includes 50 plastic components, 2x small flying bases, 1x large flying base, 4x long flying stems, and 2x short flying stems. This kit also includes 1x T'au Vehicle Transfer Sheet, containing 85 high-quality waterslide transfers for you to further decorate your model.These miniatures are supplied unpainted and require assembly – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
